question: Can you tell me the numeric value of the active council district in Austin which has the highest number of bike trips that start and end within the same district, but not at the same station?
sql:
WITH active AS (
  SELECT station_id, council_district
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.austin_bikeshare.bikeshare_stations`
  WHERE status = 'active'
),
trip_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_id, 
    end_station_id, 
    COUNT(*) AS trip_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.austin_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips`
  GROUP BY start_station_id, end_station_id
),
filtered_counts AS (
  SELECT tc.start_station_id, tc.end_station_id, tc.trip_count
  FROM trip_counts tc
  WHERE tc.start_station_id IN (SELECT station_id FROM active)
    AND tc.end_station_id IN (SELECT CAST(station_id AS STRING) FROM active)
)
SELECT 
  sl.council_district,
  SUM(fc.trip_count) AS total_trips
FROM filtered_counts fc
JOIN active sl ON fc.start_station_id = sl.station_id
JOIN active el ON CAST(fc.end_station_id AS INT64) = el.station_id
WHERE sl.council_district = el.council_district
GROUP BY sl.council_district
ORDER BY total_trips DESC
LIMIT 1
